definitions.explanation: Something made to look like the genuine article in order to deceive. Can refer to counterfeit goods, forged documents, or a person pretending to be something they are not.

examples.japanese: これは{偽物|にせもの}だ。
{偽物|にせもの}のブランド{品|ひん}を{買|か}ってしまった。
examples.english: I accidentally bought a counterfeit brand-name product.

examples.japanese: {本物|ほんもの}と{偽物|にせもの}の{見分|みわ}けがつかないほど{精巧|せいこう}にできている。
examples.english: It is so well made that you cannot tell the real thing from the fake.

notes:
The opposite of {本物|ほんもの} (the real thing). {偽物|にせもの} carries a strongly negative connotation, implying deliberate deception or fraud.

ALTERNATIVE READING:
Sometimes read as にせもの or ぎぶつ. The reading にせもの is standard.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {偽物|にせもの}をつかまされる: to be passed off a fake
- {偽物|にせもの}を{見抜|みぬ}く: to see through a fake
- {本物|ほんもの}と{偽物|にせもの}の{見分|みわ}け: distinguishing real from fake

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {偽物|にせもの}: a fake item (implies deception)
- {模造品|もぞうひん}: imitation, replica (more neutral, may be legal)
- {贋作|がんさく}: forgery (specifically art or documents)
- コピー{品|ひん}: knockoff, copy product
